findings.summary: Payment-history rows have no row header to identify which payment the remaining cell values describe.
findings.fix: Use a stable payment identifier, such as the receipt number, as a th scope=row in each history table.
findings.evidence: Each payment row began with td for payment_date, and all remaining cells were also td.

passed: Fee-balance and financial-report tables have captions, scoped column headers, and scoped fee row headers.
Payment-history tables have captions and scoped column headers.
